story: A man sits on a bench and reads a book.
His dog sits next to the bench and looks at him.
The dog wants to share the bench too!
notes: Static looping drawing (30 s), no cut: only leaves, the dog's head and tail move. Two actors (man, dog), so exercise 1 is shown. Book slot moved from the live 0.18/0.5 (on the man's leg) onto the book; bench slot moved right to keep the pills apart. Story line 3 is a light joke: the bench has room for more than one, and the dog sits on the ground looking up.
